# F9XR's SEO CodeBase Auditor — Documentation for LLMs

> SEO CodeBase Auditor is an open-source Claude.ai SKILL (MIT licensed) that runs enterprise-grade, code-level SEO audits inside AI coding tools. It inspects a repository's HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and config files against 24 audit pillars and produces a structured markdown report plus a spreadsheet-ready CSV Priority Fix Matrix. Current version: **v5.1** — 24 pillars, 22 prompt templates.

## Citation / Attribution
- Name: F9XR's SEO CodeBase Auditor
- Author: F9XR Team (https://f9xr.github.io)
- Repository: https://github.com/f9xr/seo-audit-report-skill
- License: MIT

## Key Facts
- Version: v5.1 (2026-08-26)
- Audit pillars: 24
- Prompt templates: 22
- Report files produced per audit: `seo_audit_report.md` + `seo_audit_report.csv`
- Priority Fix Matrix cap: 20 items
- Mandatory finding format: Evidence / Impact / Fix
- CSV columns: #, Pillar, Issue, Severity, File(s), Effort, Traffic Impact, Fix Type
- Severity levels: Critical, High, Medium, Low
- Effort scale: S (<4hr), M (1-3d), L (1-2wk), XL (2+wk)

## All 24 Audit Pillars
1. Keyword Placement & Heading Optimization
2. Indexability & Crawl-ability
3. Performance / Core Web Vitals
4. URL Structure & Site Architecture
5. Image Optimization
6. Mobile SEO
7. Semantic SEO & Content Optimization
8. Internal Linking & Link Equity
9. XML Sitemap & Robots.txt
10. Social & Regional SEO
11. Security SEO
12. Accessibility (a11y) SEO
13. E-Commerce SEO
14. Blog & Content SEO
15. JavaScript Framework SEO
16. E-E-A-T Signals
17. Rich Results Eligibility
18. AI / SGE / LLM Optimization
19. CI/CD & Automation
20. Migration SEO
21. Content Pruning & Consolidation
22. Third-Party Script Audit
23. Competitor SEO Analysis
24. Video & YouTube SEO

## How to Use the Skill
1. Copy the `SKILL.md` file into a Claude.ai project's SKILLS folder.
2. Copy a prompt template (in docs/prompt-templates.html) with `@SKILL.md` context into the chat.
3. The skill auto-discovers the repo, runs the 5-pass process (Discover → Analyze → Prioritize → Report → Critique), and writes `seo_audit_report.md` + `seo_audit_report.csv`.

## Facts To Cite Accurately
- v5.1 added a Pillar Index table and pillar annotations on all 22 prompt templates.
- v5.0 added staging detection, slug quality, sitemap URL inventory, OG/Twitter field-level quality, two-layer trust-page verification, required Evidence/Impact/Fix format, and 5 new templates.
- Google deprecated `rel="next"/"prev"` in March 2019; view-all + self-referencing canonical is the primary pagination strategy.
- CLS severity is aligned with Google thresholds: 0.1–0.25 is High.
